name: Impeccable UI
description: UI/UX design, scored critique, accessibility audit, typography, layout, responsive behavior and design-system refinement using Impeccable 4.8.2 references. Includes optional upstream CLI launchers; Talia hook automation requires host integration.
description_it: Design UI/UX, critica con punteggio, audit di accessibilità, tipografia, layout, comportamento responsive e raffinamento del design system con riferimenti Impeccable 4.8.2. Include launcher CLI opzionali upstream; l'automazione hook Talia richiede integrazione host.
